title: He set fire to his own pearls

lines.text: He set fire to his own pearls.
Japan, the 1930s. Kokichi Mikimoto had built his life on cultured pearls.
Now cheap, badly farmed pearls were flooding the market, and prices were falling.
Buyers began to think every cultured pearl was junk.
So in Kobe, in front of the Chamber of Commerce, he lit a fire.
And he shovelled in his own low-grade pearls, while the pearl dealers watched.
Only the best would carry his name.
Would you burn your own stock, to save your name?
